facts.fact: The Personal Data Protection Office, established by the Data Protection and Privacy Regulations 2021, says it oversees and enforces the Data Protection and Privacy Act No. 9 of 2019 and has registered 3,623 data controllers and processors.

UGA.note: No ruling against a named organisation is stated.

facts.fact: The Personal Data Protection Office says Uganda's Data Protection and Privacy Act No. 9 of 2019 is being implemented and enforced, with organisations registered and monitored under it.
facts.system: Data Protection and Privacy Act No. 9 of 2019

facts.fact: The Personal Data Protection Office, established by the Data Protection and Privacy Regulations 2021, is overseeing the Act and has been active for about three years.
The Data Protection and Privacy Regulations 2021 are stated to have established the Personal Data Protection Office.
The Office reports 3,623 data controllers and processors registered, more than 300 awareness sessions and sector guidelines for fintechs and MSMEs, with no decision stated.
The Personal Data Protection Office says it has translated the Data Protection and Privacy Act and its regulations into braille.
facts.system: braille translation of the Data Protection and Privacy Act

UGA.note: A one-off braille translation is not a rule in force or an accessible digital service.
